title: Unique Citrusy Greek Pork Skewers
description: A light and refreshing Greek dish featuring pork, perfect for a crowd, this recipe is a unique blend of citrusy flavors and traditional Greek ingredients, and is also shojin-friendly, meaning it is suitable for a Buddhist vegetarian diet with the omission of the pork, which can be replaced with a plant based alternative.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, oregano, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Add the pork cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated pork cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the pork is cooked through.
While the skewers are grilling, mix together orange zest and orange juice in a small bowl.
Brush the orange mixture onto the skewers during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
